# Research-informed planning

Read [platform setup and API contract](../resources/platform.md) before the first platform call. Resolve `SCRIPTS_DIR` as described there. Prefer the connected Grep MCP tools when they expose the needed operation; the CLI is the REST fallback.

Use the user's goals and permitted local context to identify questions requiring external evidence. Research those specific questions through Grep, then combine the cited findings with the actual local constraints. Keep assumptions and unknowns explicit.

Do not upload the entire codebase or automatically research every unfamiliar symbol. If existing documentation suffices, use it. Deliver a concrete plan with dependencies and validation appropriate to the task. Planning does not authorize deployment, purchases, or starting recurring jobs.
